## Git and data safety

- [ ] Branch starts from current `main` and uses `feature/`, `bugfix/`, or `chore/`.
- [ ] Logical feature, fix and test improvements have distinct meaningful commits.
- [ ] Staged-file safety check passed; no runtime credentials, local databases or real employee data.
- [ ] Documentation and `GIT_CHANGELOG.md` reflect scope and verified push status.
- [ ] Required checks/reviews are satisfied before requesting merge.

Use a draft PR while work or release acceptance is incomplete. Do not check boxes for tests not executed. Do not bypass protected-branch reviews.
